archetype: The Performance Pro / Precision Electrician Command Center

meta.context: Dashboard & Field Tool for Italian Electricians
meta.summary: Modern, precision-engineered electric dark theme with high-contrast tactical accents, crisp micro-borders, clean tabular data, and high-legibility print stylesheet for quotes.

entry_surfaces./: modern electrician dashboard with quick actions bar, 5 tactical KPI widgets (including new monthly hours & overdue quotes), live jobs feed and expired quotes callout list
entry_surfaces./lavori: active jobs table and split card inspector with interactive hours logger and materials consumed ledger
entry_surfaces./preventivi: quote builder workbench with client auto-picker, tiered labor/materials line items and overdue follow-up tags
entry_surfaces./preventivi/:id/stampa: clean high-contrast white printable quote paper sheet with VoltCraft header, VAT calculation, signature field
entry_surfaces./materiali: inventory stock manager with low-stock amber warning pill and quick replenishment actions
entry_surfaces./clienti: client directory table with quick-call, address, tax-id (P.IVA/CF), and linked job history count

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-5
grids_and_layouts.container_padding: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6

motion.transition_defaults: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for normal copy, 3:1 for large display)
accessibility.touch_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for all mobile and field buttons
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, modals, tabs, and key status metrics must carry semantic data-testid attributes

component_guidelines.kpi_card: Tactical card with 1px border (#1E293B), bg-[#111827], clear uppercase tracking label (text-xs font-semibold text-slate-400), prominent value (text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-mono text-white), and accent colored status sparkline or icon chip.
component_guidelines.hours_summary_widget: Special card highlighting 'Ore Lavorate Mese Corrente' + 'Valore Economico Stimato (€)' with tariffa oraria configurabile/predefinita (es. 35€/h).
component_guidelines.overdue_quotes_banner: High-urgency section flagging quotes past 30 days without response, with one-click 'Registra Follow-up' or 'Segna come Accettato/Rifiutato'.
component_guidelines.client_picker: Searchable Select or Command Popover linking clients from /clienti directly into new jobs (lavori) and quotes (preventivi).
component_guidelines.print_sheet: @media print rules ensuring background is pure white (#FFFFFF), text is dark charcoal (#0F172A), zero dark mode borders, and page breaks are clean.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retheme frontend/src/index.css by importing Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono from @fontsource-variable.

Implement the 3 requested feature sets: 1) Monthly hours summary with euro value on dashboard, 2) Client directory (Anagrafica Clienti) with client-picker in Jobs & Quotes, 3) Overdue quotes reminder with follow-up actions.
Ensure the UI is 100% in Italian with natural technical electrician terminology (Giacenza, Manodopera, Preventivo, Lavori in corso, Scaduto, P.IVA/Codice Fiscale).
Provide responsive layouts optimized for one-handed smartphone use in electrical work sites (cantiere).
Include data-testid on all inputs, select options, modals, and CTA buttons for end-to-end testing.
